content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

When considering platforms for selling ebooks, the differences between options like Gumroad and NOWPayments become stark. Gumroad provides a user-friendly interface but charges a hefty 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, making it significantly cheaper for creators. With a $97 ebook, the cost of 100 monthly sales through Gumroad would amount to $970, while NOWPayments would only take $48.5. This fundamental difference in fee structure directly impacts the creator's bottom line, allowing for greater retention of earnings. Beyond fees, creators using NOWPayments can also seamlessly integrate Bitcoin transactions, which is appealing in regions facing currency instability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in restricted countries, the choice of payment processor can either enable or hinder their business. Gumroad and similar platforms often impose geographical restrictions, making them inaccessible in many regions. Conversely, NOWPayments operates globally without the same limitations. This means creators in countries like Venezuela or Ethiopia can securely accept Bitcoin without worrying about geographical constraints. By utilizing a service that isn't bound by the same rules as conventional payment processors, digital creators can establish a truly sovereign commerce presence. The flexibility offered by NOWPayments allows individuals to focus on their craft rather than navigating complex payment barriers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed can significantly affect cash flow for digital creators. With Gumroad, delays in payment processing can be frustrating, especially when funds are needed immediately for growth or reinvestment. In contrast, NOWPayments processes Bitcoin transactions swiftly, enabling creators to receive funds as soon as they confirm on-chain. The difference in fees is also crucial; Gumroad's 10% fee means creators keep only $87 from a $97 sale, while NOWPayments retains $96.5 per sale. This cost-saving translates into greater financial freedom and enables creators to scale more efficiently without the burden of excessive processing fees.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees at just 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to digital product delivery, ownership and automation are critical components. Gumroad retains control over all transactions, making creators reliant on their platform. In contrast, using a stack built with NOWPayments, Cloudflare, and other tools allows creators to own every aspect of their business. This means creators can automate product delivery through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly without manual intervention. This level of control not only enhances efficiency but also builds trust with customers, as they experience seamless transactions without third-party interference. By owning their infrastructure, creators can pivot and adapt their offerings without restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The decision between platforms boils down to your specific situation. If you aim for maximum profitability and control, adopting a custom stack using NOWPayments and cloud services is the clear winner. Digital creators needing immediate results might feel tempted to use platforms like Gumroad, but they will pay the price in fees and ownership loss. On the other hand, investing time into building a sovereign stack with tools available in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) will set you up for long-term success. Ultimately, understanding your needs and the financial implications of each option will guide you to the best choice.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely possible by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, eliminating the restrictions imposed by traditional platforms. Creators can use cloud-based solutions for product delivery, ensuring that they maintain full ownership and control over their sales.
Automated delivery means no manual intervention required.

This kit provides you with all the tools needed to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to discover more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
